details:
Marketing API v24.0 is available until 2026-11-10, much earlier than Graph API v24.0. After that, ads calls pinned to v24.0 either fail or are auto-upgraded to the next version; endpoints that changed between versions fail. This matches ad account edges (/v24.0/act_{id}/...); calls to campaign, ad set and ad objects by numeric id on v24.0 are affected too but cannot be told apart from other Graph calls by path.

Move all Marketing API calls (ad accounts, campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, insights) to v25.0 or, better, v26.0, and re-test against the v25.0 and v26.0 changelogs (for example the Advantage+ campaign and targeting_automation changes) before 2026-11-10.
